name: concur-mcp
description: Unofficial SAP Concur tools for Claude — expense reports, expenses, receipts and trips via your signed-in browser

concur_dc.title: Concur datacenter
concur_dc.description: The datacenter from your signed-in Concur tab's host (e.g. us2 for us2.concursolutions.com). Defaults to us2.

concur_ws_port.title: Bridge port
concur_ws_port.description: The fetchproxy bridge port. The whole fetchproxy fleet and ContextMint Bridge share `37149`; override only for local testing (or when a host injects a per-registration port). Defaults to 37149.

concur_output_dir.title: Receipt download folder
concur_output_dir.description: Where `concur_get_receipt` saves downloaded receipts (never overwriting an existing file). Defaults to ~/Downloads/concur-mcp.

concur_upload_roots.title: Allowed upload folders
concur_upload_roots.description: The only folders `concur_upload_receipt` will read from (a path-delimiter-separated list; `~` expanded). Hosted (with `MCP_DATA_DIR` set) the default is `$MCP_DATA_DIR/uploads`. Defaults to the working directory, ~/Downloads, ~/Documents and ~/Desktop.

concur_inline_receipts.title: Return receipts inline
concur_inline_receipts.description: `true` makes `concur_get_receipt` return the image in the result instead of writing a file. Off locally, on when hosted.

tools.name: concur_healthcheck
tools.description: Check the Concur session: which source supplied the token, whether the API accepted it, and round-trip time

tools.name: concur_whoami
tools.description: Your Concur user id, datacenter, minutes until the session token expires, and enabled features

tools.name: concur_list_expense_types
tools.description: List the expense types a report's policy allows (id, name, group)

tools.name: concur_list_payment_types
tools.description: List the payment types you can put on an expense (cash, company card, …)

tools.name: concur_list_currencies
tools.description: List the currencies Concur accepts, optionally filtered by code or name

tools.name: concur_search_locations
tools.description: Search Concur expense locations by city (optionally country / subdivision)

tools.name: concur_list_reports
tools.description: List your expense reports by status and date range, with totals, approval and payment status

tools.name: concur_get_report
tools.description: Get one expense report: header, every expense entry, and its exceptions

tools.name: concur_get_report_timeline
tools.description: Get a report's timeline (comments and workflow events) and audit trail

tools.name: concur_get_expense
tools.description: Get one expense entry with its form fields, itemizations, receipt and exceptions

tools.name: concur_list_available_expenses
tools.description: List available expenses (card transactions, e-receipts, mobile captures) not yet on a report

tools.name: concur_create_report
tools.description: Create a new unsubmitted expense report (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_update_report
tools.description: Change an unsubmitted report's header fields (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_delete_report
tools.description: Permanently delete an unsubmitted report and its expenses (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_add_report_comment
tools.description: Add a permanent comment to a report, visible to approvers (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_submit_report
tools.description: Submit a report to your approver (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_recall_report
tools.description: Recall a submitted, not-yet-approved report back to unsubmitted (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_create_expense
tools.description: Add an expense to an unsubmitted report (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_update_expense
tools.description: Change an expense on an unsubmitted report (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_delete_expenses
tools.description: Permanently delete expenses from an unsubmitted report (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_copy_expense
tools.description: Duplicate an expense on an unsubmitted report (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_move_available_expenses_to_report
tools.description: Move available expenses onto an unsubmitted report (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_delete_available_expenses
tools.description: Permanently delete available expenses not on any report (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_list_available_receipts
tools.description: List receipt images in your receipt store that are not attached to an expense

tools.name: concur_get_receipt
tools.description: Download a receipt image to a local file (or inline)

tools.name: concur_upload_receipt
tools.description: Upload a png/jpg/pdf receipt from an allowed local folder (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_attach_receipt
tools.description: Attach a stored receipt image to an expense that has none (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_append_receipt
tools.description: Add a stored receipt image as an extra page of an expense's receipt (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_detach_receipt
tools.description: Take the receipt image off an expense (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_delete_receipt
tools.description: Permanently delete an unattached receipt image (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_list_trips
tools.description: List your Concur Travel trips (upcoming, past or all)

tools.name: concur_get_trip
tools.description: Get one trip with its flight, hotel, car and rail bookings

tools.name: concur_get_trip_history
tools.description: Get a trip's history: changes, approvals and itinerary emails

tools.name: concur_send_itinerary
tools.description: Email a trip's itinerary to recipients (confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_graphql_query
tools.description: Run a raw read-only GraphQL query against Concur (escape hatch)

tools.name: concur_graphql_mutation
tools.description: Run a raw GraphQL mutation against Concur (escape hatch, confirmation-gated)

tools.name: concur_list_operations
tools.description: List the GraphQL operations the Concur web app uses, for the escape hatches
